correctness.rationale: The proof explicitly identifies each r-transversal and every edge with complementary support among exactly 2r distinct color parts, giving a disjoint union of K_{p_I,p_Ic}. Every component is connected. Spanning-tree contraction gives the all-parameter integral homotopy and ranks. Integer row/column zero cycle matrices have an explicit unimodular four-cycle basis, identifying H1 with tensor products of augmentation lattices; shore exchange reverses orientation. All seven independent finite face-enumeration cases passed, including singleton and unequal parts, without being used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exactly 2r-color threshold is a natural boundary immediately below the recent published odd 2r+1-color graph classification. The finding gives the complete integral homotopy types for arbitrary part-size weights and all tuple arities and an orientation-sensitive integral representation of the symmetry on every component. It recovers and properly credits the isolated known 4-dimensional special case, and makes a sharp structural connectivity contrast across an infinite family. These complete natural invariants are of mathematical value without claiming a downstream paper-sized theorem.
